title: The mutation machine
desc: DNA changes letter by letter as it is copied. A rule for those changes becomes a machine of gears on a quantum computer, one per branch of a family tree, and pairs of letters that change together are coupled.
page: The mutation machine: DNA's changes as a quantum circuit
sub: DNA's changes as a quantum circuit
aria: Interactive 3D story of how DNA letters change along a family tree and how a quantum circuit models it, from a rule of change to an RNA stem
